squirtle-hydro-cannon.name: Hydro Cannon
squirtle-hydro-cannon.description: Bond skill: a blast from its shell cannons at a foe up to 3 hexes away (Power 105, Sp. Atk).

squirtle-heavy-slam.name: Heavy Slam
squirtle-heavy-slam.description: Bond skill: drops its heavy shell on a foe (Power 80, Attack), pushing it 1 hex.

squirtle-aqua-ring.name: Aqua Ring
squirtle-aqua-ring.description: Bond skill: a veil of water heals it and adjacent allies by 25% of their max HP.

squirtle-rain-dish.name: Rain Dish
squirtle-rain-dish.description: Soaks up water: heals 4% of max HP at the start of each turn.

squirtle-mega-launcher.name: Mega Launcher
squirtle-mega-launcher.description: Its Water moves deal 15% more damage.

squirtle-rapid-spin.name: Rapid Spin
squirtle-rapid-spin.description: New skill: spins its shell into a foe (Power 50), then breaks free of engagement.

squirtle-bubble-beam.name: Bubble Beam
squirtle-bubble-beam.description: New skill: a spray of bubbles at a foe up to 2 hexes away (Power 60) that Slows it for 1 turn.

squirtle-shell-armor.name: Shell Armor
squirtle-shell-armor.description: Takes 20% less damage while at full HP.

squirtle-cannon-sights.name: Cannon Sights
squirtle-cannon-sights.description: Deals 15% more damage to foes 2+ hexes away.

squirtle-scald.name: Scald
squirtle-scald.description: New skill: boiling water at a foe up to 2 hexes away (Power 70) that Burns it for 1 turn.

squirtle-withdraw.name: Withdraw
squirtle-withdraw.description: New skill: pulls into its shell; it is Fortified for 2 turns.

squirtle-hard-shell.name: Hard Shell
squirtle-hard-shell.description: Foes that hit it from an adjacent hex take 8 damage.

squirtle-squirtle-squad.name: Squirtle Squad
squirtle-squirtle-squad.description: Deals 15% more damage to foes engaged with an ally; each combo it lands gives 1 Bond.

squirtle-flash-cannon.name: Flash Cannon
squirtle-flash-cannon.description: New skill: a beam of light from its cannons hits everything in a 2-hex line (Power 85).

squirtle-shell-smash.name: Shell Smash
squirtle-shell-smash.description: New skill: breaks out of its shell; it is Focused and Hasted for 2 turns.

squirtle-arcing-cannons.name: Arcing Cannons
squirtle-arcing-cannons.description: Its ranged moves fire over Pokémon standing in the way.

squirtle-shell-wall.name: Shell Wall
squirtle-shell-wall.description: Foes engaged with it always draw its free strike when stepping away.

squirtle-water-spout.name: Water Spout
squirtle-water-spout.description: New skill: a gushing spout on a 1-hex area up to 1 hex away (Power 90).

squirtle-aqua-tail.name: Aqua Tail
squirtle-aqua-tail.description: New skill: a heavy watery tail swing (Power 85) that knocks the foe 2 hexes away.

squirtle-rinse-off.name: Rinse Off
squirtle-rinse-off.description: Sheds statuses foes put on it at the start of its turn.

squirtle-cold-current.name: Cold Current
squirtle-cold-current.description: Statuses it inflicts last 1 turn longer; deals 15% more damage to foes with a status.

squirtle-hydro-artillery.name: Hydro Artillery
squirtle-hydro-artillery.description: Capstone. Torrent: its Water moves deal 30% more below half HP; it deals 10% more damage.

squirtle-living-fortress.name: Living Fortress
squirtle-living-fortress.description: Capstone. Takes 15% less damage; foes it engages take 15% more damage from its allies.
